as LSJ said, you were right. it's because anneke's eagle sight ability
is 'always on'.

it works the other way if you're not anneke and you want to play
eagle's sight, because until you have played the eagle's sight you are
not allowed to block, and therefore cannot play 2nd trad. so you play
a wwef first, to allow you to play reaction cards, then play an
eagle's sight, to allow you to attempt to block, and then play a 2nd
trad, to attempt to block with +2 intercept.

Messages.Author: jeff...@pacbell.net
Messages.Body:
tzimisce_dragon wrote:
> A simple question:
>
> my interpretation of Anneke's ability leads to the conclusion that even
> tapped,

> she can play a 2nd tradition:domain to untap and attempt to block (with +2
> int)

The "attempt to block" is the crux of the answer. Since 2nd Tradition
forces the reacting vampire to "attempt to block" they can't play 2nd
Tradition unless they have the option of attempting said block.
Normally that's blocking a (D) action or predator/prey blocking an
undirected action. Anneke is always able to try and block any action
per her special unless cards played disallow it.

Jeff
